items.text: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown listed OUT; Dallas Goedert IN on ETR Week 5 board.
items.why: Friday final board; Goedert cleared IN after prior absence
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps depleted in London; Goedert returns as top TE target
items.opportunity: RB snaps to Will Shipley/Dameon Pierce/Carson Steele; WR targets to Dontayvion Wicks and others; Goedert red-zone/ dual-threat TE role expands

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson (plus Trey Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens) for Sunday night vs Falcons.
items.why: Official team ruling confirmed by Schefter
items.opportunity: Henry lead back; Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume up

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start Sunday vs Giants, but WR Stefon Diggs out due to hamstring.
items.implication: Daniels back under center; Diggs missed
items.opportunity: Full Daniels dual-threat; WAS WR redistribution

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets and fantasy points; pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname. Usage and matchup driven, ties to possible Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Target share + soft matchup + potential WR absences boost

items.text: Breece Hall and AD Mitchell listed OUT on ETR Sunday injuries.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining Jets RBs

items.text: Quentin Johnston and Michael Pittman listed OUT.
items.why: ETR board; Schefter confirmed Johnston OUT with others
items.implication: LAC and PIT WR depth charts shift
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey (Q) or other Chargers WRs; PIT WR targets up for remaining

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN on final ETR board (not on injury report).
items.implication: Expected to play with potential expanded role

items.text: Ashton Jeanty QUESTIONABLE; Chris Olave IN (with Noah Fant). Many other Qs including Chase/Higgins, Jefferson/Addison, McConkey, Flowers, McLaurin, Kamara, Stevenson.
items.why: Comprehensive Friday board; Levitan notes ridiculous Q list bracing messy Sunday AM
items.implication: Game-time decisions galore; monitor AM reports
items.opportunity: If Jeanty out, backup RBs; Olave full go; Chase/Higgins absences boost other CIN

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans off injury report with no designation; Bosa and Juszczyk ruled out.

Jeremiyah Love tough projection spot but as of now 4.8 points clear of Allgeier in DK; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior Week 4 usage drag; not on final IR. Accounts for downside but expects upgrade.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on usage + cleared report; data in projections
items.implication: Stronger RB2/flex with clearer path to touches
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share expected; 4.8 DK pts clear of backup
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance and long-year risk could limit

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift has no injury designation; Kyle Monangai ruled out.
items.implication: Swift clear lead/featured; Monangai out multiple weeks possible

items.text: Love love LOVE Nico Collins @ TEN; has him as WR8. Volume including red zone vs defense struggling vs WRs.

Loves: Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5), Jared Goff/Stafford/Dak. Hates: Jordan Addison, Mark Andrews, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts (London/banged line). Usage/matchup driven.
items.why: Volume, coverage mismatches, game environment; hates on role/efficiency/tough spots
items.implication: Start loves; fade hates in rankings/lineups
items.opportunity: Wilson/Watson/Likely target upside; reverse for hates

items.text: Broncos placed WR Pat Bryant on injured reserve; promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey.
items.implication: Out at least through early Nov
items.opportunity: DEN WR depth chart shuffle; more for Courtland Sutton/others
